page.about.lede.zh: Structural 是一个跨领域思维引擎。它检索一个值得检验的可能性：看似无关的现象，可能共享可比较的变量关系、反馈或方程骨架。这类相似只形成候选，不等于机制相同；每一对仍需核对变量映射、来源、反例和真实数据。
page.about.lede.en: Structural is a cross-domain thinking engine. It searches for a testable possibility: apparently unrelated phenomena may share comparable variable relationships, feedback, or an equation skeleton. Such similarity is a candidate lead; it does not establish the same mechanism. Each pair still requires checks of the variable mapping, sources, counterexamples, and real data.

page.about.goal.title.zh: 整体目标 · 把"发现跨域同构"系统化
page.about.goal.title.en: Overall goal — systematizing the discovery of cross-domain isomorphism

page.about.goal.p1.zh: 科学史上的一些关键突破——Shannon 用热力学的熵建立信息论、Black-Scholes 把热传导方程搬到期权定价、模拟退火把冶金过程变成组合优化——都是"同一个数学骨架第一次被搬到另一个领域"的瞬间。传统上这类跨域借用依赖极少数通才的偶然洞察。
page.about.goal.p1.en: A number of pivotal moments in the history of science — Shannon importing thermodynamic entropy into information theory, Black and Scholes carrying the heat equation into option pricing, simulated annealing recasting a metallurgical process as combinatorial optimization — are all instances of the same mathematical skeleton being transplanted into a new domain for the first time. Historically, such cross-domain borrowings have depended on the serendipitous insight of a small number of polymaths.

page.about.goal.p2.zh: Structural 想把偶然的跨领域联想变成可搜索、可质疑、可验证的研究流程。系统先提出候选结构，再要求核对变量、机制、来源、反例和失败条件。候选不是论文结论；领域专家仍需收集真实数据、确认引用并承担作者责任。
page.about.goal.p2.en: Structural turns accidental cross-domain analogy into a searchable, challengeable, and testable research workflow. The system proposes a candidate structure, then asks for variables, mechanism, sources, counterexamples, and a failure criterion. A candidate is not a paper conclusion; domain experts must still collect real data, verify citations, and take author responsibility.

page.about.why.p1.zh: 当你在自己的领域里遇到难题，其他学科的模型或实验设计也许能提供候选思路。相似骨架只提示“值得比较”——术语、变量和边界条件仍需逐项映射，借用的方法也要在当前问题中验证。
page.about.why.p1.en: When you hit a hard problem in your field, models or experiment designs from another discipline may provide candidate ideas. A similar skeleton only says “worth comparing”—terms, variables, and boundary conditions still require mapping, and any borrowed method must be validated in the current problem.

page.about.why.p2.zh: Claude Shannon 借用热力学的"熵"奠定了信息论。Black 和 Scholes 把热传导方程搬到金融市场上得到了期权定价公式。模拟退火算法把冶金学的物理过程变成了组合优化的利器。这些跨领域的突破不是偶然——它们都是结构同构被发现的瞬间。Structural 想做的是把这种"发现"系统化。
page.about.why.p2.en: Claude Shannon founded information theory by borrowing entropy from thermodynamics. Black and Scholes derived the option-pricing formula by transplanting the heat equation into financial markets. Simulated annealing turned a metallurgical process into a powerful tool for combinatorial optimization. These cross-domain breakthroughs are not accidents — each is a moment when a structural isomorphism was recognized. Structural exists to make that recognition systematic.

page.about.how.intro.zh: 普通搜索主要找字面或语义接近的内容。Structural 还尝试比较变量关系、反馈和阈值等“数学骨架”。这只会产生值得检查的候选：提取结构草案 → 跨学科检索 → 内部 AI 筛查 → 记录支持、反对或证据不足，不会自动证明机制相同。
page.about.how.intro.en: Ordinary search primarily finds text with similar wording or meaning. Structural also compares candidate variable relationships, feedback loops, and thresholds — a plain-language sense of a mathematical skeleton. This produces leads to inspect, not proof that two systems share a mechanism.

page.about.how.v1.p1.zh: 用 text2vec-base-chinese 作为 backbone，在 84 种结构类型 × 1,214 条人工标注样本上做对比学习微调（MultipleNegativesRankingLoss）。目标是让"同一结构的不同领域描述"在 768 维空间中互相靠近，"不同结构"互相推开。训练完成后 Silhouette 0.85、Retrieval@5 100%。
page.about.how.v1.p1.en: We use text2vec-base-chinese as the backbone and fine-tune it via contrastive learning (MultipleNegativesRankingLoss) on 1,214 manually annotated examples spanning 84 structural types. The objective is to pull descriptions of the same structure from different domains close together in 768-dimensional space, while pushing apart descriptions of different structures. After training, Silhouette = 0.85 and Retrieval@5 = 100%.

page.about.how.v1.p2.zh:
路径：自然语言描述 → V1 embedding → cosine 相似度 → top-k。
优势：召回广（在 4,443 KB 上找到 339,913 对高相似跨域配对）。
缺点：精度一般，"共享关键词"和"共享数学"区分不够。
角色：宽撒网——找潜在候选，不保证质量。
page.about.how.v1.p2.en:
Path: natural-language description → V1 embedding → cosine similarity → top-k.
Strengths: broad recall (339,913 high-similarity cross-domain pairs across the 4,443-item KB).
Weaknesses: modest precision — the model does not cleanly separate "shared keywords" from "shared mathematics".
Role: wide net — surfacing candidates without guaranteeing quality.

page.about.how.v2.p1.zh: 相同的 backbone，但训练集扩到 5,689 条（V1 原始 + 4,475 条新扩展），多了一倍的负样本和跨领域对。这让模型变得更"挑剔"——在同一个 4,443 KB 上只产出 4,533 对高相似配对（严格度是 V1 的 75×）。
page.about.how.v2.p1.en: Same backbone, but the training set is expanded to 5,689 examples (the original V1 set plus 4,475 newly added items), roughly doubling the negatives and cross-domain pairs. The resulting model is substantially more selective — on the same 4,443-item KB it returns only 4,533 high-similarity pairs, a 75× tightening relative to V1.

page.about.how.v2.p2.zh:
路径：自然语言 → V2 embedding → cosine → top-k。
评估：Silhouette 0.55（比 V1 在扩展集上更好）、Retrieval@5 96%。
角色：精度检索——同样是 embedding，但更能分辨浅层关键词相似。
page.about.how.v2.p2.en:
Path: natural language → V2 embedding → cosine → top-k.
Evaluation: Silhouette = 0.55 (better than V1 on the expanded set), Retrieval@5 = 96%.
Role: precision retrieval — still embedding-based, but markedly better at discounting shallow lexical overlap.

page.about.how.v3.intro.zh: 前两代的 embedding 都是"统计相关"——把文本映射到向量空间看距离。V3 换了一个哲学：如果结构同构的本质是共享数学方程，就必须显式地表达这些方程，不是用相关性近似它。
page.about.how.v3.intro.en: The first two generations are statistical: they map text into a vector space and read off distances. V3 takes a different stance — if structural isomorphism is fundamentally about sharing a mathematical equation, then the equation itself must be represented explicitly, not approximated through correlation.

page.about.how.v3.bullets_intro.zh: 我们用 Kimi/Opus 把 4,443 现象每一条都抽取成一个结构化元组（StructTuple），字段包括：
page.about.how.v3.bullets_intro.en: Using Kimi and Opus, we extract each of the 4,443 phenomena into a structured tuple (StructTuple) whose fields include:

page.about.how.v3.bullet1.zh: state_vars — 随时间变化的状态变量
page.about.how.v3.bullet1.en: state_vars — the state variables that evolve over time

page.about.how.v3.bullet2.zh: dynamics_family — 动力学族：ODE1_exponential_decay / DDE_delayed_feedback / PDE_reaction_diffusion / Bistable_switch / Network_cascade / Phase_transition_1st 等 27 个枚举值
page.about.how.v3.bullet2.en: dynamics_family — the dynamical family, drawn from 27 enumerated values: ODE1_exponential_decay, DDE_delayed_feedback, PDE_reaction_diffusion, Bistable_switch, Network_cascade, Phase_transition_1st, and so on

page.about.how.v3.bullet5.en: timescale_log10_s — the order of magnitude of the characteristic timescale

page.about.how.v3.bullet6.zh: canonical_equation — 可推断的方程骨架（如 dx/dt = f(x(t-τ)) - g(x)）
page.about.how.v3.bullet6.en: canonical_equation — an inferable equation skeleton, e.g. dx/dt = f(x(t-τ)) - g(x)

page.about.how.v3.match_logic.zh: 检索时用字段级硬匹配：dynamics_family 不同直接拒绝；同族才进入细粒度评分。这过滤掉了"两个现象都含'反馈'、'阈值'但机制完全不同"的关键词陷阱。通过后再用 LLM pairwise rerank 做第二次过滤，每对输出 shared_equation 和 variable_mapping。
page.about.how.v3.match_logic.en: Retrieval proceeds by field-level hard matching: a mismatch on dynamics_family is an immediate reject, and only same-family pairs advance to fine-grained scoring. This filters out the classic keyword trap in which two phenomena both mention "feedback" or "threshold" while operating under entirely different mechanisms. Surviving pairs are then re-ranked by a pairwise LLM pass that emits a shared_equation and a variable_mapping for each.

page.about.how.v3.role.zh:
路径：自然语言 → LLM 推断 dynamics_family → StructTuple 字段匹配 → LLM rerank → 带候选方程骨架和变量映射的结果。
内部观察：历史内部评分在不同管道间有差异，但评分未做外部校准，不是正确率或论文质量证明。
角色：生成可核查的结构草案；方程、变量对应和引用必须由领域专家复核后才能进入研究方法。
page.about.how.v3.role.en:
Path: natural language → LLM inference of dynamics_family → StructTuple field matching → LLM rerank → results with a candidate equation skeleton and variable mapping.
Internal observation: historical internal scores differ across pipelines, but they are not externally calibrated and are neither correctness rates nor evidence of paper quality.
Role: generate an inspectable structural draft; domain experts must verify its equation, variable mapping, and sources before it can enter a research method.

page.about.how.parallel.title.zh: 三条管道，候选集合不同

page.about.how.parallel.p.zh: 历史筛选各保留了 V1 的 24 条、V2 的 19 条和 V3 的 20 条候选，在当时的候选 ID 口径下没有重复。这个集合差异可能来自召回空间、阈值、提示词或抽样，不足以证明三条管道分别发现了结构的不同本质。并集作为 SIBD-63 保存 63 条历史候选；“63”是记录数，不是独立性或质量等级。
page.about.how.parallel.p.en: Historical screening retained 24 V1, 19 V2, and 20 V3 candidates, with no duplicate candidate IDs under the definitions used at the time. That set difference could arise from retrieval space, thresholds, prompts, or sampling; it does not show that the pipelines discovered distinct underlying facets. Their union is preserved as SIBD-63: 63 is a record count, not a claim of independence or quality.

page.about.how.v4.title.zh: V4 · 普适类发现引擎（universality class engine）

page.about.how.v4.intro.zh: V1–V3 产出离散的候选配对。V4 把共享节点或相似描述的配对聚合成候选结构组，例如把地震、市场波动、DeFi 清算和神经雪崩放在同一组中比较。聚类只说明它们值得用统一变量表和反例检验；不能据此证明任意两者同构，也不能推出一个更底层的共同规律。
page.about.how.v4.intro.en: V1–V3 produce discrete candidate pairs. V4 groups pairs that share nodes or similar descriptions into candidate structural groups, for example placing earthquakes, market fluctuations, DeFi liquidations, and neural avalanches in one comparison set. Clustering only makes them worth testing with a common variable ledger and counterexamples; it does not establish pairwise isomorphism or a deeper common law.

page.about.how.v4.layer1.zh: Layer 1 · 图建模——把 SIBD-63 建成图，节点 = 领域现象，边 = 同构对；对语义相近的节点做别名归并（node_aliases.json，人工白名单 + LLM 建议）。
page.about.how.v4.layer1.en: Layer 1 · Graph construction — represent SIBD-63 as a graph in which nodes are domain phenomena and edges are isomorphism pairs, with semantically close nodes merged via an alias table (node_aliases.json, a manual whitelist augmented by LLM suggestions).

page.about.how.v4.layer2.zh: Layer 2 · 连通分量 + Louvain 社区——用 NetworkX 算 connected components 和 Louvain community，得到 23 个 candidate universality classes。
page.about.how.v4.layer2.en: Layer 2 · Connected components and Louvain communities — compute connected components and Louvain communities with NetworkX, yielding 23 candidate universality classes.

page.about.how.v4.layer3.zh: Layer 3 · LLM 精编——每个 candidate 过 Opus 审核：命名（如 "Branching-process SOC"）、核心方程（P(s)∝s⁻ᵗ、γ=(α-1)/(τ-1)）、hub domain、典型 exponent 范围、literature status。
page.about.how.v4.layer3.en: Layer 3 · LLM curation — each candidate is reviewed by Opus, producing a name (e.g. "Branching-process SOC"), core equations (P(s)∝s⁻ᵗ, γ=(α-1)/(τ-1)), a hub domain, typical exponent ranges, and literature status.

page.about.how.v4.layer4.zh: Layer 4 · 可验证预测——每个类提炼 1-5 个"如果成立，某个分布/指数就会是这个值"的 falsifiable prediction（共 24 个）。
page.about.how.v4.layer4.en: Layer 4 · Falsifiable predictions — for each class we distill one to five falsifiable predictions of the form "if the class holds, such-and-such distribution or exponent will take this value" (24 in total).

page.about.how.v4.layer5.zh: Layer 5 · 证据评估——对较可操作的 SOC 候选记录“数据 → 拟合 → 局限”流程；结果包含支持、拒绝和证据不足，不等于实证确认。
page.about.how.v4.layer5.en: Layer 5 · Evidence assessment — for a tractable SOC candidate, record the data → fit → limitations workflow. Outcomes include support, rejection, and insufficient evidence; this is not empirical confirmation.

page.about.how.v4.role.zh: 角色：候选组织器——把 V1-V3 的离散联系归入 23 个待检验结构家族，便于逐领域提出预测和反例。一个领域的结果不能替其他领域完成验证；每项仍待独立复现。浏览候选：/classes。
page.about.how.v4.role.en: Role: candidate organizer — grouping V1–V3 links into 23 structural families so predictions and counterexamples can be tested per domain. A result in one domain cannot validate another; each remains pending independent replication. Browse the candidates at /classes.

page.about.empirical.title.zh: 结果记录 · 同一分析框架在多类数据上的表现
page.about.empirical.title.en: Result records · one analysis framework across varied data

page.about.empirical.intro.zh: 项目保存了 13 份领域分析与合成对照的结果记录（口径冻结于 2026-07-12，证据账本 v1）。它们复用分析框架，但数据接入、预处理、独立性和证据强度不同；结果包含支持、拒绝、NULL、PARTIAL 和 INCONCLUSIVE，不能算作 13 次独立机制复现。
page.about.empirical.intro.en: The project retains 13 domain-analysis and synthetic-control result records (scope frozen on 2026-07-12, evidence ledger v1). They reuse an analysis framework but differ in data access, preprocessing, independence, and evidence strength. Outcomes include support, rejection, NULL, PARTIAL, and INCONCLUSIVE — not 13 independent mechanism replications.

page.about.empirical.phase1.zh: Phase 1 · 地震 / USGS 84k events：历史分析记录 b-value = 1.084、p = 0.941、τ ≈ 1.67。⚠️ 与候选范围相容；未完成预注册、稳健性审计和独立复现，不能据此确认机制。
page.about.empirical.phase1.en: Phase 1 · Earthquakes (USGS, 84k events): a historical analysis records b-value = 1.084, p = 0.941, and τ ≈ 1.67. ⚠️ Compatible with the candidate range; without preregistration, robustness audit, and independent replication, this does not confirm a mechanism.

page.about.empirical.phase2.zh: Phase 2 · S&P 500 日线：历史分析记录 α ≈ 3.00、p = 0.29。⚠️ 统计观察；数值与部分文献范围接近，但尚不足以确认连续扩散亚类，也不能与地震合并为同一机制。
page.about.empirical.phase2.en: Phase 2 · S&P 500 daily series: a historical analysis records α ≈ 3.00 and p = 0.29. ⚠️ Statistical observation; proximity to selected literature ranges does not establish a continuous-diffusion subclass or a mechanism shared with earthquakes.

page.about.empirical.phase3.zh: Phase 3 · DeFi 清算级联（Aave V2 + Compound V2 + MakerDAO，43,065 events）：历史分析记录的 per-protocol α = 1.57-1.68。⚠️ 跨协议统计相似——协议并非三个独立自然系统，指数接近也不能证明共同机制。
page.about.empirical.phase3.en: Phase 3 · DeFi liquidation cascades (Aave V2 + Compound V2 + MakerDAO, 43,065 events): a historical analysis records per-protocol α = 1.57–1.68. ⚠️ Cross-protocol statistical similarity — the protocols are not three independent natural systems, and similar exponents do not prove a common mechanism.

page.about.empirical.phase4.zh: Phase 4 · 小鼠皮层神经雪崩（DANDI 000006）：历史拟合的 size exponent τ、lifetime γ 与 task-state 亚临界假说部分相容。⚠️ 候选观察；这不是对 Priesemann 2014 的独立复现，仍需替代模型与独立分析。
page.about.empirical.phase4.en: Phase 4 · Neuronal avalanches in mouse cortex (DANDI 000006): historical fits of size exponent τ and lifetime γ are partly compatible with the task-state sub-critical hypothesis. ⚠️ Candidate observation; this is not an independent replication of Priesemann et al. (2014) and still requires alternative models and independent analysis.

page.about.empirical.phase5.zh: Phase 5 · 合成对照：特定 Poisson / Gaussian 样本在当时配置下未被选为幂律。这个有限对照可发现部分实现错误，但不能排除预处理、模型选择或数据依赖偏差；真实领域结论仍待独立复现。
page.about.empirical.phase5.en: Phase 5 · Synthetic controls: selected Poisson and Gaussian samples were not classified as power laws under the recorded configuration. This bounded control can reveal some implementation errors, but cannot exclude preprocessing, model-selection, or data-dependent bias; real-domain conclusions remain pending independent replication.

page.about.empirical.closing.zh: 分析脚本、研究报告 Markdown 和数据下载脚本保存在仓库中；当前材料是内部研究记录，不代表同行评审或外部发表。可从 /classes 查看结果与局限。
page.about.empirical.closing.en: Analysis scripts, research-report Markdown, and data-download scripts are retained in the repository. These are internal research records, not peer-reviewed or externally published papers. Results and limitations are available from /classes.

page.about.empirical.significance.zh: 意义：共享代码让不同结果可比较，并保留失败和证据不足；它建立的是可审计的研究起点，不是跨域机制已经成立的证明。
page.about.empirical.significance.en: Significance: shared code makes unlike outcomes easier to compare while retaining failures and insufficient evidence. It creates an auditable research starting point, not proof of a shared cross-domain mechanism.

page.about.scoring.title.zh: 本次检索顺序是怎么形成的
page.about.scoring.title.en: How this query's ranking is formed

page.about.scoring.intro.zh: Beta 站的 /api/search 用混合排序融合四个信号。该值只服务于同一次查询中的先后排序：
page.about.scoring.intro.en: The beta /api/search endpoint combines four signals for ranking. The resulting value is used only to order candidates within one query:

page.about.scoring.signal1.zh: BM25 词项命中（权重 0.45）— 用 jieba 中文分词后做 BM25-Okapi，衡量查询词和现象描述的词汇重合度。先 min-max 归一化到 [0, 1]。
page.about.scoring.signal1.en: BM25 term overlap (weight 0.45) — jieba-tokenized Chinese text scored with BM25-Okapi, measuring lexical overlap between the query and each phenomenon description. Min-max normalized to [0, 1].

page.about.scoring.signal2.zh: V2 embedding 余弦相似（权重 0.55）— 把查询和现象描述都过 V2 模型，计算 768 维向量的 cosine 相似度。同样先 min-max 归一化到 [0, 1]。
page.about.scoring.signal2.en: V2 embedding cosine similarity (weight 0.55) — both query and phenomenon are passed through the V2 model, and the cosine similarity of the 768-dimensional vectors is taken. Also min-max normalized to [0, 1].

page.about.scoring.signal3.zh: StructTuple dynamics_family boost（+0.10）— 从查询关键词推断动力学族（"延迟"→DDE_delayed_feedback、"阈值"→Phase_transition_1st 等），给 StructTuple 里匹配的现象加一个轻奖励。
page.about.scoring.signal3.en: StructTuple dynamics-family boost (+0.10) — the dynamical family is inferred from query keywords (e.g. "delay" → DDE_delayed_feedback, "threshold" → Phase_transition_1st), granting a small bonus to phenomena whose StructTuple matches.

page.about.scoring.signal4.zh: 领域多样性保护（MMR）（后置过滤）— 如果 top-5 有超过 2 个同领域结果，把多余的推到 top-10 位置，保证跨域结果的多样性。
page.about.scoring.signal4.en: MMR domain-diversity guard (post-filter) — if more than two entries in the top-5 come from the same domain, the surplus are pushed down into the top-10 range to preserve cross-domain diversity.

page.about.scoring.formula.zh: 内部排序值 = 0.45 × BM25 + 0.55 × embedding + 0.10 × dynamics_boost。各查询都会重新归一化和重排，因此前端只显示序位，不显示百分比或强弱档位。
page.about.scoring.formula.en: The internal ranking value is 0.45 × BM25 + 0.55 × embedding + 0.10 × dynamics_boost. Each query is normalized and reranked anew, so the UI shows position rather than a percentage or strength tier.

page.about.scoring.tier1.zh: 序位 — 只表示候选在当前输入下的相对先后，不可跨查询比较
page.about.scoring.tier1.en: Position — relative order for the current input only; it cannot be compared across queries.

page.about.scoring.tier2.zh: 相邻差距 — 不是效果量、置信度或成功概率，不能据此判断机制
page.about.scoring.tier2.en: Gaps between positions — not an effect size, confidence, or success probability, and not evidence of mechanism.

page.about.scoring.tier3.zh: 所有结果 — 都是待核查候选；需要来源、反证、边界条件和独立验证

page.about.next.intro.en: SIBD-63 preserves 63 historical candidates (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19615170, CC-BY-4.0). Thirty-nine passed internal AI screening for candidate display; that is neither peer review nor mechanism confirmation. Next steps are source enrichment, preregistered failure criteria, real-data tests, and independent domain-expert review.

page.about.next.item1.zh: Seed bank outreach——把 63 个候选分门别类发给对口方向的学术团队（生态 / 金融 / 材料 / 神经 / DeFi），让领域专家挑与自己专长匹配的 seed 做成论文，Structural 获得 co-author / acknowledgement / 被引。
page.about.next.item1.en: Seed-bank outreach — route each of the 63 candidates to matched academic groups (ecology, finance, materials, neuroscience, DeFi), so that domain experts can pick up seeds aligned with their expertise and develop them into papers, with Structural credited as co-author, acknowledged, or cited.

page.about.next.item2.zh: 其他候选模式评估——把 Layer 5 的证据工作流用于另外 22 个候选，逐项写明数据、替代解释、失败条件与独立复现状态。
page.about.next.item2.en: Assessment of further candidate patterns — apply the Layer 5 evidence workflow to 22 additional candidates, documenting data, alternative explanations, failure criteria, and independent-replication status for each.

page.about.next.item3.en: Methodology assessment — use the 13 mixed-strength result records as a benchmark, add preregistration, negative cases, and independent replication, then determine whether a submission-ready methodology claim is warranted.

page.about.next.item4.en: Phase Detector research demo — use candidate patterns for historical state replay on frozen data (open the Phase product). It is not real-time detection, prediction, or an investment signal.

page.home.tagline.zh: 看似无关的现象，可能包含值得检验的结构相似。

page.home.lede.zh: 描述你的问题，从 87 个学科的 4,443 个现象里，寻找可检验的结构类比与方法候选。
page.home.lede.en: Describe your problem and search 4,443 phenomena across 87 disciplines for testable structural analogies and candidate methods.

page.home.hero_evidence.caption_1.zh: 在明确假设下，它们可用同一类数学模型描述；机制是否一致仍需验证。
page.home.hero_evidence.caption_1.en: Under explicit assumptions, the same model family can describe both; shared mechanism still requires validation.

page.home.hero_evidence.caption_2.zh: 细菌增长和产品扩散都可尝试用逻辑斯谛模型族比较；参数与机制需分别检验。
page.home.hero_evidence.caption_2.en: Bacterial growth and product diffusion can be compared with a logistic model family; their parameters and mechanisms require separate tests.

page.home.hero_evidence.caption_3.zh: 病毒与信息扩散可提出SIR 类候选映射；接触、恢复和传播假设并不相同。
page.home.hero_evidence.caption_3.en: Virus and information diffusion invite a candidate SIR-like mapping; contact, recovery, and transmission assumptions differ.

page.home.hero_evidence.caption_4.zh: 磁滞与湖泊翻转可用尖点灾变候选模型比较；是否落在同一模型上仍需数据检验。
page.home.hero_evidence.caption_4.en: Magnetic hysteresis and lake regime shifts can be compared with a candidate cusp-catastrophe model; data must test whether either model is appropriate.

page.home.hero_evidence.caption_5.zh: 弹簧与市场波动可提出受驱振子类比；市场反馈不等于机械回复力。
page.home.hero_evidence.caption_5.en: Springs and market fluctuations invite a driven-oscillator analogy; market feedback is not a mechanical restoring force.

page.home.how.sub.zh: 从一句话描述到一份可执行的跨学科研究报告，约需 2–3 分钟。
page.home.how.sub.en: From a one-sentence description to an actionable cross-disciplinary research report in about two to three minutes.

page.home.how.step1.text.zh: 把口语化描述改写成检索问题，再从 4,443 个跨学科现象中排序 20 个待核查候选；序位不代表结构等价。
page.home.how.step1.text.en: Your informal description is rewritten as a retrieval question, then used to rank 20 candidates from 4,443 cross-disciplinary phenomena. Rank does not establish structural equivalence.

page.home.how.step2.text.zh: 模型只在真实 Top-K 来源内比较候选，列出建议先核查的记录、证据缺口、竞争解释、失败条件和下一步检验。完整输出通过 schema 与来源白名单后才会展示。
page.home.how.step2.text.en: The model compares only the real Top-K source records, identifying what to inspect first plus evidence gaps, competing explanations, failure conditions, and the next test. Nothing is shown until the complete output passes schema and source-allowlist validation.

page.home.how.step3.text.zh: 点首推卡 → 8 段流式生成的研究草案：候选结构、关键变量、源领域的方法线索、怎么检验在当前问题中的适用性、待验证假设和迁移风险。
page.home.how.step3.text.en: Click the recommended card to stream an eight-section research draft: candidate structure, key variables, method leads from the source domain, tests of applicability to the current problem, open hypotheses, and transfer risks.

page.home.usecases.sub.zh: 输入你正被困住的问题，系统提出候选结构和其他领域的方法线索；是否适用仍需核对变量、边界与反例。
page.home.usecases.sub.en: Enter the problem you are stuck on; the system proposes candidate structures and method leads from other domains. Applicability still requires checks of variables, boundaries, and counterexamples.

page.home.usecases.card1.sample.zh: 地震、股价跳跃、神经雪崩都曾报告重尾或幂律拟合；仅凭这些形状不能确认共同机制，下一步该检验什么？ →
page.home.usecases.card1.sample.en: Earthquakes, stock-price jumps, and neural avalanches have each been fitted with heavy-tailed or power-law models; those shapes alone cannot establish a common mechanism, so what should be tested next? →

page.home.usecases.card1.value.zh: 自组织临界（SOC）候选类 · 历史结果记录比较了地震、DeFi 清算和神经雪崩的部分统计量，并同时保留 PARTIAL、NULL 与局限；配套材料是内部研究稿，不是外部复现。
page.home.usecases.card1.value.en: Candidate Self-Organized Criticality (SOC) class · historical result records compare selected statistics from earthquakes, DeFi liquidations, and neural avalanches while retaining PARTIAL and NULL outcomes and limitations. The companion materials are internal research drafts, not external replications.

page.home.usecases.card2.title.zh: 产品 · 用户流失分析

page.home.usecases.card2.sample.zh: 我们月活用户按固定比率掉 7%，怎么看怎么干预？ →
page.home.usecases.card2.sample.en: Our monthly active users are dropping at a fixed 7% rate — how should we read it, and how should we intervene? →

page.home.usecases.card2.value.zh: 一阶指数衰减候选 · dN/dt = −λN——可把固定比例流失先与放射性衰变、药物浓度等衰减曲线作结构比较。业务流失通常还有分群、获客和季节因素，半衰期不是唯一参数；先检验拟合与反例，再决定干预。
page.home.usecases.card2.value.en: Candidate first-order exponential decay · dN/dt = −λN — fixed-rate churn can first be compared with decay curves from radioactivity or drug concentration. Business churn also reflects cohorts, acquisition, and seasonality, so half-life is not the only parameter; test the fit and counterexamples before acting.

page.home.usecases.card3.sample.zh: 团队氛围一旦变差就回不去了——为什么会这样？ →
page.home.usecases.card3.sample.en: Once team morale goes bad, it never comes back — why? →

page.home.usecases.card3.value.zh: 双稳态 / 磁滞候选——团队状态可先与磁化、湖泊富营养化等“前进与恢复路径不同”的现象比较。类比只提示检查阈值和记忆效应，不证明团队遵循尖点灾变或 fold 分岔；需用纵向数据排除更简单解释。
page.home.usecases.card3.value.en: Candidate bistability / hysteresis — team state can be compared with systems whose forward and recovery paths differ, such as magnetization or lake eutrophication. The analogy only suggests checking thresholds and memory effects; it does not establish a cusp catastrophe or fold bifurcation, and longitudinal data must rule against simpler explanations.

page.classes.footnote_l1.zh: Layer 1 图构建：读取 V1/V2/V3 中带 A、B+ 内部评分标签的候选，按 final_score ≥ 7.0 OR rating ∈ {A, B+} 过滤，得到 180 节点 / 143 边。标签只用于当时的内部筛选，不代表正确性或证据质量。
page.classes.footnote_l1.en: Layer 1 — Graph construction: candidates carrying internal A or B+ score labels in V1/V2/V3 are filtered by final_score ≥ 7.0 OR rating ∈ {A, B+}, yielding 180 nodes and 143 edges. These labels supported internal triage; they do not establish correctness or evidence quality.

page.classes.footnote_l2.zh: 当前数据边界：候选总数、原队列数与后加候选数均由当前加载记录计算。
page.classes.footnote_l2.en: Current data boundary: candidate totals, original-queue counts, and later-candidate counts are computed from the currently loaded records.

page.classes.footnote_l3.zh: Layer 3 分类假设：带有人工来源标签的候选分组与文献命名模式关联，供后续检验。这个关联是分类标签，不等于确认物理普适类或共享机制。
page.classes.footnote_l3.en: Layer 3 — Taxonomy hypothesis: candidate groups carrying a human-source label were associated with named patterns from the literature for later testing. The association is a taxonomy label, not confirmation of a physical universality class or shared mechanism.

page.classes.footnote_l4.zh: Layer 4 假设草拟：参考文献中报告的关系，为其他领域草拟可证伪假设。迁移是否成立仍取决于变量映射、真实数据、替代解释和预先声明的失败标准。
page.classes.footnote_l4.en: Layer 4 — Hypothesis drafting: literature-reported relationships are used to draft falsifiable hypotheses for other domains. Any transfer still depends on variable mapping, real data, alternative explanations, and predeclared failure criteria.

page.classes.footnote_l5.zh: Layer 5 结果记录：领域分析与合成对照使用共享代码框架，但数据依赖和证据强度不同。记录包含支持、拒绝、部分支持和证据不足；不等于外部复现。
page.classes.footnote_l5.en: Layer 5 — Result records: domain analyses and synthetic controls share a code framework, but their dependence and evidence strength differ. Records include support, rejection, partial support, and insufficient evidence; they are not external replications.

page.classes.footnote_l6.zh: 合成对照记录：在当时配置下，3 组已选非 SOC 样本（高斯、指数、Poisson）未被选为幂律（R ∈ [−45, −16]，Poisson Omori R² ≈ 0.002）。这个有限对照可发现部分实现错误，不能排除其他生成过程、预处理或模型选择偏差。
page.classes.footnote_l6.en: Synthetic-control record: under the recorded configuration, three selected non-SOC samples (Gaussian, exponential, and Poisson) were not selected as power laws (R ∈ [−45, −16]; Poisson Omori R² ≈ 0.002). This bounded control can reveal some implementation errors but cannot exclude other generators, preprocessing choices, or model-selection bias.

page.classes.footnote_hint.zh: 完整 feasibility 报告见 v4/results/FINDINGS-2026-04-15.md，完整 V4 规划见 plans/v4-universality-class-engine.md。
page.classes.footnote_hint.en: Full feasibility report: v4/results/FINDINGS-2026-04-15.md. Full V4 plan: plans/v4-universality-class-engine.md.

page.discoveries.hero_lede.zh: 这里收录的是由模型提出、等待核查的跨领域配对。公开页面不展示未校准分数、投稿建议或机制结论。当前所有条目都停留在候选层：先补来源、数据、比较方法、主指标和失败条件，再决定是否在实验前公开锁定研究方案（预注册）。

page.about.empirical.results.zh: 记录中既有与候选预测相容的统计量，也有 NULL、FAIL、PARTIAL 和 INCONCLUSIVE。地震、市场、DeFi 与神经数据的历史拟合只能说明某些统计形状值得继续比较；不能单凭指数接近推出同一机制。合成对照用于检查代码行为，也不能排除所有方法偏差。逐项数据、版本和限制见结果记录与证据账本 v1（2026-07-12）。
page.about.empirical.results.en: The records include statistics compatible with candidate predictions as well as NULL, FAIL, PARTIAL, and INCONCLUSIVE outcomes. Historical fits on earthquake, market, DeFi, and neural data identify shapes worth comparing; similar exponents alone do not establish a shared mechanism. Synthetic controls check code behavior but cannot eliminate every methodological bias. See the result records and evidence ledger v1 (2026-07-12) for inputs, versions, and limits.

page.about.how.example1.en: Earthquakes and stock-market flash crashes — a candidate comparison focuses on slow build-up and sudden-release statistics; similar shapes do not establish the same driving mechanism.

page.about.how.example2.zh: 神经雪崩和电网级联——都可提出“局部事件沿连接传播”的候选模型，但网络、因果方向和证据仍需分别检验。
page.about.how.example2.en: Neural avalanches and power-grid cascades — both invite a candidate model of local events propagating along connections, while their networks, causal direction, and evidence require separate tests.

page.about.how.example3.en: DeFi liquidations and bank runs — leverage, thresholds, and stress propagation can be mapped for comparison; cross-protocol statistical similarity remains a research lead.

page.about.how.example4.zh: 野火和太阳耀斑——历史结果曾比较事件大小分布；当前只作为候选统计类比，不作普适机制结论。
page.about.how.example4.en: Wildfires and solar flares — historical records compared event-size distributions; this remains a candidate statistical analogy, not a universal-mechanism conclusion.

page.about.how.examples_intro.en: Here is what this pipeline actually finds in practice:

page.about.how.flow.zh: 系统从描述中提取状态变量、反馈结构和候选方程，再聚合相似现象。多个 AI 配置只用于内部筛查，不等于外部同行评审。部分候选随后进入共享分析代码，结果可能是支持、拒绝、NULL、PARTIAL 或 INCONCLUSIVE；每条仍需检查数据来源、替代解释和独立复现。
page.about.how.flow.en: The system extracts state variables, feedback structures, and candidate equations, then groups similar phenomena. Multiple AI configurations provide internal screening, not external peer review. Some candidates enter shared analysis code, producing support, rejection, NULL, PARTIAL, or INCONCLUSIVE results; every claim still requires source checks, alternative explanations, and independent replication.

page.about.how.outcome.zh: 每条候选提供变量映射、可能的方程、反例方向和下一步实验草案，供领域专家判断是否值得继续；它不是可直接投稿的结论。候选模式见 /classes。
page.about.how.outcome.en: Each candidate offers a variable mapping, possible equation, counterexample direction, and next-experiment draft so a domain expert can decide whether to continue. It is not a submission-ready conclusion. Candidate patterns are listed at /classes.

page.classes.footnote_l7.zh: AI 内部筛查记录：AI 配置只对原队列候选生成内部处理标签，用于安排人工复核优先级。这些配置不是独立同行评审，也不能验证分类方法。详见 筛查记录。
page.classes.footnote_l7.en: Internal AI screening record: AI configurations only produced internal handling labels for original-queue candidates to prioritize human review. They are not independent peer review and do not validate the taxonomy method. See the screening record.

page.methods.b3_limit_text.zh: 同厂商 AI 审稿团探测的是同模型族内的判定漂移,不是跨架构分歧。跨厂商审稿(其他 LLM 家族)因地区访问限制推迟到后续版本。
page.methods.b3_limit_text.en: A single-vendor review panel only detects intra-family verdict drift, not cross-architecture disagreement. Cross-vendor review (other LLM families) is deferred to a future version due to regional access constraints.

page.methods.b3_p1.zh: 候选模式太多或命名太松会污染整个分类。分类假设阶段使用同一厂商模型族的三个配置，对 21 个候选分别给出保留 / 拒绝 / 拆分 / 合并的内部筛查票。多数票只用于安排人工复核优先级，不是独立评审。
page.methods.b3_p1.en: Too many candidate patterns or overly loose names can pollute the taxonomy. At the taxonomy-hypothesis stage, three configurations from one vendor's model family cast internal screening votes—keep, reject, split, or merge—on 21 candidates. A majority only prioritizes human review; it is not independent review.

page.methods.b3_p2.zh: 共识分布: 保留 5 / 拒绝 7 / 拆分 5 / 合并 4。详细投票矩阵见 审稿结果。
page.methods.b3_p2.en: Consensus breakdown: keep 5 / reject 7 / split 5 / merge 4. Full voting matrix at /taxonomy-v2.

page.methods.b3_p3.zh: 内部观察 — 相似错误标签: 同厂商的三个模型配置都把 4 个初始候选标为“可能把数学工具误当机制”。这种一致可用于发现待人工复核项，但由于模型同源、提示与样本未独立，它不是方法论有效性的验证。
page.methods.b3_p3.en: Internal observation — a similar error label: three configurations from one vendor flagged four initial candidates as possibly mistaking mathematical tools for mechanisms. This agreement can prioritize human review, but shared model provenance, prompts, and samples mean it is not validation of the methodology.

page.methods.l1_desc.zh: 读取前几代检索中带 A、B+ 内部评分标签的候选，按当时阈值过滤，得到 180 节点 / 143 边的现象关联图；标签不代表正确性或证据质量。
page.methods.l1_desc.en: Read candidates carrying internal A or B+ score labels from earlier retrieval generations and filter them by the recorded threshold, yielding a phenomenon graph of 180 nodes / 143 edges; the labels do not establish correctness or evidence quality.

page.methods.l2_desc.zh: 用社区发现算法(Louvain)在关联图上聚簇,得到 23 个候选等价类,21 个跨 ≥ 2 领域。
page.methods.l2_desc.en: Run a community-detection algorithm (Louvain) on the graph to cluster nodes, yielding 23 candidate equivalence classes, 21 of which span ≥ 2 domains.

page.methods.l3_desc.zh: 把算法生成的候选分组关联到文献中的命名模式，作为待检验的分类假设；关联标签不等于确认物理普适类或共享机制。
page.methods.l3_desc.en: Associate algorithm-generated candidate groups with named patterns in the literature as taxonomy hypotheses for testing; an association label does not confirm a physical universality class or shared mechanism.

page.methods.l4_desc.zh: 参考文献中报告的关系草拟跨领域可证伪假设；每项迁移仍需核对变量映射、数据、替代解释和失败标准。
page.methods.l4_desc.en: Use literature-reported relationships to draft cross-domain falsifiable hypotheses; each transfer still requires checks of variable mapping, data, alternative explanations, and failure criteria.

page.methods.l5_desc.zh: 共享分析模块用于多份领域数据和合成对照。结果并不一致：有支持、拒绝、部分支持、NULL 和证据不足。合成对照检验代码行为，不替代真实系统的机制证据。
page.methods.l5_desc.en: Shared analysis modules are used on multiple domain datasets and synthetic controls. Outcomes differ: support, rejection, partial support, NULL, and insufficient evidence. Synthetic controls test code behavior; they do not replace real-system mechanism evidence.

page.methods.lede.zh: 共享代码只能保证分析步骤可比较，不能保证数据独立、机制相同或结论成立。这里记录从候选模式到真实/合成数据测试的流程，并保留支持、拒绝、NULL、PARTIAL 和 INCONCLUSIVE 结果。
page.methods.lede.en: Shared code makes analysis steps comparable; it does not guarantee independent data, a common mechanism, or a positive conclusion. This page records the path from candidate patterns to real/synthetic tests while preserving support, rejection, NULL, PARTIAL, and INCONCLUSIVE outcomes.

page.methods.null_p1.zh: 为检查代码是否会把明显的非幂律样本也拟合成幂律，我们记录了 4 个合成对照（Gaussian 随机游走、指数变量、Poisson 事件、Poisson 余震叠加）。在当时配置下这些样本未被选为幂律（记录的 R ∈ [-45, -16]，Poisson 余震 R² ≈ 0.002）。这个小型对照只覆盖已选生成过程，不能排除其他方法偏差。
page.methods.null_p1.en: To check whether the code also labels obvious non-power-law samples as power laws, we recorded four synthetic controls (Gaussian random walk, exponential variates, Poisson events, and Poisson-aftershock superposition). Under the recorded configuration they were not selected as power laws (R ∈ [-45, -16]; Poisson-aftershock R² ≈ 0.002). This small control set covers only the chosen generators and cannot exclude other methodological bias.

page.methods.null_p2.zh: 另有一份探索性形态对照：在有限尺寸标度假设和既定归一化下，7 份领域曲线记录 r<sub>shape</sub> = 1.11；当时的模型选择在 5/7 中偏向幂律 + 指数 cutoff。阈值、领域选择和预处理均非预注册，因此这只是候选观察，不能证明 7 个领域发生同一 collapse 或共享机制。
page.methods.null_p2.en: A separate exploratory shape comparison records r<sub>shape</sub> = 1.11 for seven domain curves under a finite-size-scaling assumption and a selected normalization; the recorded model selection favored power law plus exponential cutoff in 5/7. The threshold, domains, and preprocessing were not preregistered, so this is a candidate observation—not proof of one collapse or a shared mechanism across seven domains.

page.methods.null_p3.zh: 完整研究规划见 GitHub,统一研究报告见 研究报告。
page.methods.null_p3.en: Full research plan on GitHub; unified pipeline report at research report.

page.methods.pipeline_p1.zh: 多份领域记录复用一个 Python 分析模块（查看代码 →）；数据接入、预处理和运行配置仍需逐项审计。模块提供以下分析操作：
page.methods.pipeline_p1.en: Multiple domain records reuse a Python analysis module (view source →); ingestion, preprocessing, and run configuration still require per-record audit. The module provides these operations:

page.methods.pipeline_p2.zh: 不同领域复用共享分析模块，但数据接入、预处理和适用参数可能因数据而异。复用提高可比性；在缺少逐项配置与来源审计时，不能声称整条管道完全未修改、未调参或未使用先验。
page.methods.pipeline_p2.en: Domains reuse shared analysis modules, while ingestion, preprocessing, and applicable parameters may differ by dataset. Reuse improves comparability; without a per-run configuration and provenance audit, we cannot claim that the full pipeline was unchanged, untuned, or free of priors.

page.taxv2.lede.zh: 21 个候选分组接受了同一厂商模型家族的三种 AI 配置内部筛查。每种配置给出保留 / 拒绝 / 拆分 / 合并标签；多数标签只用于安排人工复核优先级，不是独立同行评审或分类方法验证。共记录 63 次输出、0 次解析错误和 40.8 分钟总耗时。方法细节见方法页。
page.taxv2.lede.en: Twenty-one candidate groups received internal screening from three configurations in one vendor's model family. Each configuration assigned keep / reject / split / merge labels; the majority label only prioritizes human review and is neither independent peer review nor validation of the taxonomy method. The record contains 63 outputs, 0 parse errors, and 40.8 minutes of wall time. See the methods page.

page.taxv2.limit_p1.zh: (a) 同厂商配置 — 三种 AI 配置来自同一家厂商，只能观察同模型家族内的标签漂移，不是独立同行评审，也不能代表跨架构分歧。其他 LLM 家族因地区访问限制与备用路由尚未验证而未纳入。
page.taxv2.limit_p1.en: (a) Same-vendor configurations — the three AI configurations come from one vendor. They only reveal label drift within a model family, are not independent peer review, and do not represent cross-architecture disagreement. Other LLM families were not included because regional access and the fallback route remain unverified.

page.taxv2.limit_p2.zh: (b) 21 个候选是已发现的子集 — 社区发现浮现 23 个候选,审稿评议了 21 个。"应当存在但没被社区发现浮现"的类无法靠审稿补回来,需要回到前几代检索加新现象。
page.taxv2.limit_p2.en: (b) 21 is a subset of what's discoverable — community detection surfaced 23 candidates; the panel reviewed 21. Classes that "should exist but were never surfaced by community detection" cannot be recovered by review alone — they require returning to earlier retrieval generations to add new phenomena.

page.taxv2.limit_p3.zh: 内部筛查原始输出与每条标签理由公开在 GitHub，多数标签结果在 GitHub，汇总表在 GitHub。
page.taxv2.limit_p3.en: The raw internal-screening outputs and reasons for each label are public on GitHub; majority-label results are at GitHub; the summary table is at GitHub.

page.taxv2.meta_desc.zh: 21 个候选分组接受了同一厂商模型家族三种配置的内部筛查。多数标签只用于安排人工复核，不是独立同行评审或分类方法验证。
page.taxv2.meta_desc.en: Twenty-one candidate groups received internal screening from three configurations in one vendor's model family. Majority labels only prioritize human review; they are not independent peer review or validation of the taxonomy method.

page.taxv2.pattern_p1.zh: 4 个候选在内部筛查中收到降级标签（延迟微分债务、Preisach 作为单一类、无标度渗流类、尾部 copula 传染）。共同待核查点是：这些候选可能把可复用的数学工具误当成跨领域机制证据。
page.taxv2.pattern_p1.en: Four candidates received downgrade labels in the internal screen (delay-differential debt; Preisach as one class; scale-free percolation; tail-copula contagion). The shared review question is whether a reusable mathematical tool was mistaken for cross-domain mechanism evidence.

page.taxv2.pattern_p2.zh: 延迟微分方程、Preisach 积分、无标度生成模型、copula 联合分布族是可描述多种机制的数学工具，本身不是机制。同厂商三种模型配置给出相似标签，只是内部筛查观察；它们共享训练谱系，不能作为方法论验证。
page.taxv2.pattern_p2.en: Delay-differential equations, Preisach integrals, scale-free generative models, and copula joint distributions are mathematical tools that can describe multiple mechanisms; they are not mechanisms themselves. Similar labels from three same-vendor configurations are an internal screening observation, not methodological validation, because the models share a training lineage.

page.taxv2.pattern_p3.zh: Preisach 待检验项: 把 Preisach 当作单一跨域机制的候选已被降级。NGSIM US-101 上的交通拟合、磁滞与毛细类比目前都只是各领域观察；一次数据拟合不确认真实机制，各子类仍需领域对照和独立复现。
page.taxv2.pattern_p3.en: Preisach item pending tests: the candidate that treated Preisach as one cross-domain mechanism was downgraded. The traffic fit on NGSIM US-101 and the magnetic and capillary analogies remain per-domain observations; one dataset fit does not confirm a physical mechanism, and each subclass requires domain controls and independent replication.
